39:22.text: Is he whose breast Allâh has opened to Islâm, so that he is in light from His Lord
? So woe to those whose hearts are hardened against remembrance of Allâh! They are in plain error!

39:23.text: Allâh has sent down the Best Statement, a Book
oft-repeated. The skins of those who fear their Lord shiver from it
(when they recite it or hear it)
. Then their skin and their heart soften to the remembrance of Allâh. That is the guidance of Allâh. He Guides therewith whom He wills; and whomever Allâh sends astray, for him there is no guide.

39:24.text: Is he then, who will confront with his face the awful torment on the Day of Resurrection
(as he who enters peacefully in Paradise)
? And it will be said to the Zâlimûn

39:25.text: Those before them belied, and so the torment came on them from directions they perceived not.

39:26.text: So Allâh made them to taste the disgrace in the present life, but greater is the torment of the Hereafter if they only knew!

39:27.text: And indeed We have put forth for men, in this Qur’ân every kind of similitude in order that they may remember.

39:28.text: An Arabic Qur’ân, without any crookedness
in order that they may avoid all evil which Allâh has ordered them to avoid, fear Him and keep their duty to Him.

39:29.text: Allâh puts forth a similitude: a
(like those who worship others along with Allâh)
disputing with one another, and a
man belonging entirely to one master
. Are those two equal in comparison? All the praises and thanks be to Allâh! But most of them know not.

39:31.text: Then, on the Day of Resurrection, you will be disputing before your Lord.
